raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a line chart titled "Massive Activation of baseline," illustrating the maximum activation values across different layers of a neural network. The horizontal axis (x-axis) is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 22, with tick marks at integer intervals. The vertical axis (y-axis) is labeled "Max Activation Value" and spans from 0 to 1600, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 200. Four distinct data series are plotted, each represented by a different line style and color: "attn_output" (dashed blue line), "attn_residual" (dotted orange line), "ffn_output" (dashed green line), and "ffn_residual" (solid red line). All lines remain near zero from Layer 0 to Layer 4. At Layer 5, the "ffn_residual" (red) and "attn_residual" (orange) lines sharply rise to approximately 1400 and 1450, respectively, and remain relatively flat until Layer 21, where they drop abruptly. The "ffn_output" (green) line also rises at Layer 5 to about 1400, drops to near zero by Layer 6, and remains low until Layer 21, where it spikes again to around 1200 before falling. The "attn_output" (blue) line stays near zero until Layer 21, where it rises to approximately 200. The legend is positioned in the center-right of the plot, clearly associating each line with its corresponding label. The chart uses a white background with black gridlines and axis lines, and all lines are clearly distinguishable by their color and style.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: 该图表展示了在不同网络层（Layer）上四种组件的最大激活值（Max Activation Value）的变化情况。横轴为“Layer”，范围从0到22，以整数刻度均匀标记，单位为层编号。纵轴为“Max Activation Value”，范围从0到1600，以200为间隔均匀标记，单位为激活值。图中包含四条数据线：蓝色虚线（attn_output）在层0至5之间保持在0，从层5开始缓慢上升，在层22处达到约200；橙色点线（attn_residual）在层0至5之间保持在0，从层5开始迅速上升，在层6达到约1450，之后在层6至21之间保持在约1550至1600之间，层22处下降至约1400；绿色虚线（ffn_output）在层0至5之间保持在0，层5处跃升至约1400，随后在层6至12之间下降至约0，在层13至15之间再次上升至约1000，之后下降至约0，在层21处再次跃升至约1200，层22处下降至约600；红色实线（ffn_residual）在层0至5之间保持在0，层5处跃升至约1400，层6至20之间保持在约1500至1600之间，层21处开始下降，在层22处降至约400。所有线条在层0至5之间均处于低激活状态，之后在层5附近出现显著上升，且在层21至22之间普遍下降。

Four distinct data series are represented: "attn_output" as a blue dashed line with no markers, "attn_residual" as an orange dotted line with no markers, "ffn_output" as a green dash-dotted line with no markers, and "ffn_residual" as a red solid line with no markers. The "attn_output" line remains near 0 for layers 0 to 20, then rises sharply to approximately 200 at layer 22. The "attn_residual" line starts at 0, rises steeply to around 1400 at layer 5, remains nearly flat at approximately 1500 through layer 20, and then drops to about 400 at layer 22. The "ffn_output" line is near 0 from layer 0 to 5, spikes to about 1400 at layer 5, drops to near 0 at layer 7, rises again to approximately 1000 at layer 13, drops to near 0 at layer 15, and then spikes to about 1200 at layer 20 before falling to around 400 at layer 22. The "ffn_residual" line remains near 0 until layer 5, where it rises sharply to about 1400, stays nearly constant at approximately 1500 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to about 400 at layer 22. All lines show sharp transitions around layer 5 and layer 20, with the "attn_residual" and "ffn_residual" lines maintaining high activation values between layers 5 and 20.
